decisions.reason: The Black Edition range moved from a mention to its own page in 2024, which signals results meeting aspirations; it extends the established line at low cost, and the slack of a growing firm in a growing industry supports keeping it.
CeraFrame Liquid has kept its own page for two years and fits the firm's goal of seamless, barrier-free bathrooms, so it appears satisfactory and gives no trigger for problemistic search.

The pump-drain channel is a recent launch whose results are still uncertain, and the earlier pump solution C was withdrawn, but F appears to be its successor and organisational slack lets the firm carry it while it proves itself.
